item.title: Halfpast 1.2
item.description:
Halfpast 1.2

  • Every place on its own clock. Each row now shows that place's own hours. Places half an hour off yours sit half a cell over — Bangalore's 8 lands in the middle of Singapore's 10. The ends of each row fade into yesterday and tomorrow.
  • Keep now in the middle. A new switch in Places & appearance keeps the present at the centre, twelve hours either side, with the rows drifting as the day goes by.
